1.t: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),

3.t: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).

5.t: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)

7.t: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!

8.t: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
